glossary.definition: (1) "Aircraft" has the same meaning as in section 4561.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4563.30 - Rules regarding security of airports.

glossary.definition: (2) "Airport" has the same meaning as in section 4561.01 of the Revised Code except that it does not include any airport operated by a multi-state authority or any airport with scheduled commercial air carrier service.
glossary.source_title: Section 4563.30 - Rules regarding security of airports.

glossary.definition: (3) "Private-use airport" means an airport used exclusively by the owner of the airport and by persons the owner authorizes.
glossary.source_title: Section 4563.30 - Rules regarding security of airports.

glossary.definition: (4) "Public-use airport" means an airport available for use by the general public without the prior approval of the owner or operator except as federal law or regulation require.
glossary.source_title: Section 4563.30 - Rules regarding security of airports.
